items.title: Defunding of global weather observation systems threatens climate forecasts, WMO warns
items.summary: Global weather and climate observation systems face significant funding shortfalls as governments redirect capital toward defense.

items.title: Swiss Re forecasts 2.8% global economic growth and 1% non-life premium expansion for 2027
items.summary: Swiss Re Institute projects moderate global economic growth and insurance market trends for 2027, highlighting rising debt and claims costs.

items.title: Marsh Re appoints Beth Foster as Senior Vice President of Broking
items.summary: Beth Foster joins Marsh Re in London as Senior Vice President of Broking to develop the firm's contingency offering.

items.title: Cowbell outlines 2027 UK cyber insurance trends and AI-driven risks
items.summary: Cowbell's UK team has released its 2027 predictions, pointing to growing talent demand and new commercial exposures stemming from artificial intelligence.

items.title: Milburn report recommends delaying auto-enrolment age reduction to 2031
items.summary: The Milburn review into UK youth unemployment has recommended that the auto-enrolment age should not fall to 18 until 2031 at the earliest.

items.title: Professional Pensions sets registration deadline for UK Pensions Awards 2027
items.summary: Professional Pensions has announced that registration for the UK Pensions Awards 2027 closes today.
